content:
# Disagreement Log — 1QM Column 6

| # | Line | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Category | Resolution |
|---|------|------|-------|--------|----------|------------|
| 1 | 6:7 | "lots-of-engagement" | "lots of engagement" | "rounds" | Terminology | SOPHIA: "rounds of engagement" — "lots" is opaque; "rounds" conveys the military context |
| 2 | 6:7 | "Sons-of-Light" | "Sons of Light" | "children of light" | Sectarian title | SOPHIA: "Sons of Light" — capitalized proper designation per DSS scholarship |
| 3 | 6:7 | "Sons-of-Darkness" | "Sons of Darkness" | "forces of darkness" | Sectarian title | SOPHIA: "Sons of Darkness" — PNEUMA's "forces" loses the personal/communal dimension |
| 4 | 6:8 | "the-great-hand-of-God" | "the great hand of God" | "the mighty hand of God" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "the great hand of God" — follows Hebrew gadol literally; "mighty" is interpretive |
| 5 | 6:8 | "Belial" | "Belial" | "the Devil" | Proper name | SOPHIA: "Belial" preserved — the scroll's own name; "the Devil" is anachronistic |
| 6 | 6:8 | "angels-of-his-dominion" | "angels of his dominion" | "angelic allies" | Register | SOPHIA: "angels of his dominion" — preserves dominion/governance language |
| 7 | 6:9 | "holy-ones shall-shine-forth" | "holy ones shall shine forth" | "holy warriors will blaze forth" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "holy ones shall shine forth" — "warriors" and "blaze" are PNEUMA additions |
| 8 | 6:10 | "congregation-of-the-divine-ones" | "congregation of the divine ones" | "the heavenly host" | Terminology | SOPHIA: "congregation of divine beings" — compromise between awkward "divine ones" and generic "heavenly host" |
| 9 | 6:12 | "trumpets-of-the-slain" | "trumpets of the slain" | "trumpets of slaughter" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "trumpets of the slain" — "slaughter" shifts from result to act |
| 10 | 6:14 | "spreading-outward to-cause-fear" | "spreading outward to cause fear" | "to strike terror into the enemy" | Register | SOPHIA: "spreading outward to cause fear" — PNEUMA's "strike terror" exceeds the Hebrew |
| 11 | 6:16 | "tender-of-mouth" | "soft of mouth" | "responsive to the rein" | Equestrian idiom | SOPHIA: "soft of mouth" per LOGOS — preserves the Hebrew idiom; PNEUMA explains rather than translates |
| 12 | 6:16 | "long-of-wind" | "long of wind" | "with great endurance" | Idiom | SOPHIA: "long of wind" — retains the Hebrew equestrian idiom |
| 13 | 6:17 | "men-of-valor" | "men of valor" | "brave" | Register | SOPHIA: "men of valor" — preserves gibbore chayil biblical register |
